```artifact
Feature: System Availability and Data Management

  Scenario: System Availability
    Given the system is operational
    When the current day is the 2nd Sunday of the month
    Then the system should be unavailable for a maximum of 10 minutes

  Scenario Outline: Nightly Full Backup
    Given the system is operational
    When the time is <time>
    Then a full backup of the system data should be initiated

    Examples:
      | time       |
      | 23:59:59   |  # Normal value
      | 00:00:00   |  # Edge value
      | 23:59:58   |  # Edge value

  Scenario Outline: Rollback by a Month
    Given the system is operational
    When a rollback request is made
    Then the system should revert to the state from <days> days ago

    Examples:
      | days |
      | 30   |  # Normal value
      | 29   |  # Edge value
      | 31   |  # Invalid value

  Scenario: Backup Restoration on Dummy Production System
    Given a full backup is completed
    When the backup is restored on the dummy production system
    Then the dummy production system should have the same data as the primary system

  Scenario: Purge Dummy Production Database
    Given the backup has been restored on the dummy production system
    When the purge command is executed
    Then the dummy production database should be empty

  Scenario: Data Storage in Fireproof Cabinet
    Given the system data is stored in Mangalore HQ
    When the data storage location is checked
    Then the data should be in a fireproof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital

  Scenario: Compliance with Health Care Regulations
    Given the system is operational
    When the system compliance is checked
    Then the system should comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
```
